text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: person x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: book x is written by person y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Created(x, y) ::: person x created y.
AmericanCity(x) ::: x is an American city.
Premises:
¬Novel(podcast) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x ∀y ((BornIn(x, y) ∧ AmericanCity(y)) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ∀y ((Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y)) → NovelWriter(y)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ∧ PublishYear(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
AmericanCity(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
NovelWriter(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
